title: Siege of Burgos (1475)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Burgos (1475)", at revision 1370739879, opens: "The siege of Burgos was a siege of the castle of Burgos in the Kingdom of Castile between 1475 and early 1476. It was part of the War of the Castilian Succession. Isabella's supporters and the Aragonese successfully besieged the castle, which was held by Joanna's (Juana) supporters and the Portuguese." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q55633152, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1475 siege during the War of the Castilian Succession". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
